inputs: Unchanged 20% native reviewer route, FP32, up to two preceding sentences, 96 tokens. Fit only official train.
selection: Choose methods on the fixed 48 validation judgments. Old 72 for historical comparison. Fresh 96 primary, entire judgments. Previously examined validation scores elsewhere in project may exist.
primary: Pooled seven-class macro-F1 on every nonblank sentence. Paired intervals resample judgments. Compare current reviewer, each physical edit and a label-shuffled matched-norm control.

query_methods.temperature: Scale each original query head's 64 rows and biases together using 12 closed-form coefficients.
query_methods.conditional: Closed-form rank-four final attention query matrix/bias update conditioned on the entering CLS state. Four supervised query-output directions and 40 whitened input dimensions.
query_methods.objective: Class-weighted one-hot residual versus unchanged review scores. Frozen Jacobian at the donor. Nonzero grid on selector. Identity eligible. No optimizer steps.
query_methods.heldout_test: Use previous 1 macro-F1 point and positive lower paired bound on fresh cases to consider official retest.
